name: /history
description: Search older work events by keyword, date, or browse all

steps.action: Ask the user what they want to search for
steps.context: Ask what to search for: keyword, date range, or recent 50. Then use the shared launcher operation `history` with separate literal arguments: --keyword TEXT, --since YYYY-MM-DD and/or --until YYYY-MM-DD, or no arguments for recent 50. No grep/find/ls dependency. Report omitted results; never interpolate search text into executable shell syntax.

steps.action: Display matching events and offer next steps
steps.context: Show matching events with timestamp, machine, and work focus summary. Then offer: (A) Read full event, (B) Search again, (C) Back to work.
